cons.zh: configure bit3 = 0 且未锁定才可改
cons.en: changeable only if configure bit3 = 0 and not locked

role.zh: 权限位（1 = 禁止）：bit0 claim · bit1 lock · bit2 ext_info · bit3 characteristic · bit4 claim 前转移 · bit5 claim 后转移 · bit6 claim 前销毁 · bit7 claim 后销毁
role.en: permission bits (1 = forbidden): bit0 claim · bit1 lock · bit2 ext_info · bit3 characteristic · bit4 transfer before claim · bit5 transfer after claim · bit6 destroy before claim · bit7 destroy after claim

cons.zh: 只能单向置位（除非批准）

cond.zh: 输入中该 class cell 恰 1 个；issued 增加
cond.en: exactly 1 input with this class type; its issued increases

cond.zh: 同 class 的 NFT 输出数 = 增量，token id 依次为 [a..b)
cond.en: NFT outputs of this class = the increase, token ids [a..b) in order

cond.zh: NFT configure = 输入 class configure

title.zh: 更新 / 转移 / claim / lock

inputs.label: NFT cell
inputs.body: Cell{ lock: A, type: NFT, data: { characteristic, configure, state, extinfo } }

cond.zh: characteristic 改变需权限且未锁定；configure 不变
cond.en: characteristic change needs permission and no lock; configure unchanged

cond.zh: 未批准时：claim 需未锁定且允许；不可取消 claim；lock 需允许；不可解锁
cond.en: without approval: claim needs unlocked + allowed; no un-claim; lock needs permission; no unlock

cond.zh: lock 改变 = 转移：需未锁定，且按 claim 状态被 configure 允许
cond.en: lock change = transfer: must be unlocked and allowed by configure for the claim state

cond.zh: 允许时只能追加且未锁定；不允许时长度不变
cond.en: if allowed: append-only and unlocked; otherwise length unchanged

cond.zh: 未批准时：未锁定，且按 claim 状态被 configure 允许
cond.en: without approval: unlocked and allowed by configure for the claim state

notes.zh: 版本：wiki Lina-Mainnet-deployment 写明部署提交 b5af002，Aggron-Testnet-deployment 写明 d0a844d；两者合约代码只差 helper.rs 中 CLASS_TYPE_CODE_HASH 常量（主网 0xd51e…3d9a / 测试网 0x095b…e3fc）。之后的提交只调整目录结构与 capsule 版本。未做可复现构建。
notes.en: Version: the wiki Lina-Mainnet-deployment page names deployment commit b5af002 and Aggron-Testnet-deployment names d0a844d; the contract code differs only in helper.rs CLASS_TYPE_CODE_HASH (mainnet 0xd51e…3d9a / testnet 0x095b…e3fc). Later commits only restructure directories and bump capsule. No reproducible build was attempted.

notes.zh: “批准”（helper.rs）：cell_deps[0] 的 lock = inputs[0] 的 lock，且 cell_deps[0] 的 type hash[0..20] = issuer id 或 type = 本 class。批准时跳过 claim / lock 规则和销毁规则。解码器不读取 cell_deps，所以这些规则不满足时显示为“未检查”。
notes.en: "Approval" (helper.rs): cell_deps[0] lock = inputs[0] lock, and cell_deps[0] type hash[0..20] = issuer id or its type = this class. With approval the claim / lock rules and the destroy rules are skipped. The decoder does not load cell_deps, so those rules show as "not checked" when unmet.

notes.zh: 按源码原样：configure 不允许 ext_info 时只比较数据长度，等长但内容不同的修改能通过。
notes.en: As written: when configure forbids ext_info, only the data length is compared, so a same-length content change passes.

notes.zh: NFT 合约内置 class type code hash（构建常量），所以主网 / 测试网二进制不同。动作按同一 class 的所有 NFT 计数。
notes.en: The NFT script embeds the class type code hash (a build constant), so the mainnet and testnet binaries differ. The action counts all NFTs of the same class.

notes.zh: 规则 40（helper.rs）：找到第一个带此 type 的输入，取它的 lock，再找第一个使用该 lock 的输入；该位置的 WitnessArgs.lock 必须存在（witness 缺失或解析失败也算缺失），用于禁止 ACP 这类不签名的 lock 更新 / 销毁。
notes.en: Rule 40 (helper.rs): take the first input with this type, take its lock, find the first input with that lock; the WitnessArgs.lock at that index must be present (a missing or unparsable witness counts as absent). It blocks signature-less locks such as ACP from updating / destroying.
